crosswalks.label: Information Security Analysts
crosswalks.rationale: Information Security Analysts include monitoring security of digital information and response-related tasks adjacent to security operations.

crosswalks.label: Defensive Cybersecurity
crosswalks.rationale: NICE defensive cybersecurity work provides detection/analysis context; incident command and risk acceptance remain separate.

findings.summary: Security Operations must keep telemetry/detection coverage, alert state and incident confirmation distinct while preserving source/privacy boundaries and escalation discipline.
findings.rationale: Research-backed boundary is compiled into package-local machinery.

gaps_against_body.description: Make alert-versus-incident, telemetry-loss and quiet-detection truth boundaries explicit.

nonclaims: No complete Security Operations Analyst reconstruction is claimed.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No technical access, package construction, role label, model capability or repository permission creates legal, security, safety, privacy, risk, product or institutional authority.
